title: Oahu Fly Fishing
specs: Largest bonefish on Oahu, averaging 4-6 pounds, with fish over 10 pounds possible
Sight fishing on flats with 25-60 bonefish visible per day, sometimes over 100
Mix of flats boat fishing and wading depending on conditions
includes: Use of high quality sage rods and reels
Quality flies tied specifically for Hawaii
Lunch (provided on full day trips only)
blurb: Guests stalk and sight fish for large bonefish on Oahu's unique flats, using a mix of flats boat fishing and wading. Bonefish average 4-6 pounds, with opportunities for fish exceeding 10 pounds. Fishing is year-round with best conditions in warmer summer months.
extraNote: Prices include $1 ocean stewardship fee per customer · Recommended to reserve 6-8 weeks in advance · Trip times flexible to tides, weather, and guest constraints · Bonefish available year round, best in warmer summer months
